issues.description: The problem specification and UML require SealSaloon.calculateRemainingOrderNumber() to return an int (the number of remaining orders). The solution implements calculateRemainingOrderNumber() as void and only prints order numbers instead of returning the remaining-orders integer. This mismatch will confuse students and cause tests that expect an int return value to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the method signature in SealSaloon to public int calculateRemainingOrderNumber() and return the number of remaining orders (e.g., return this.orders.length). If printing the order numbers is desired for demonstration, keep the prints but also return the computed integer. Also remove the off-by-one logic (do not use orders.length + 1).
